## MutexProtectedPointerReadRelease_00585d20 — MutexProtectedPointerReadAt5B4

**Summary:** Acquires mutex at offset 0x5B8, reads pointer value from offset 0x5B4 under protection, releases mutex, and returns the read value. Thread-safe read accessor for shared pointer field at offset 0x5B4.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND
